<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Legacy Care · Parts Planning Hub</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --brand:#4F3EAF;--brand-sub:#F0EEFF;--brand-bd:#C4BAF0;
  --bg:#F6F7F9;--surface:#FFFFFF;--surface3:#F1F2F6;
  --bd:#E6E8EF;--bd-lt:#F0F1F6;--bd-md:#D1D5E0;
  --t1:#111827;--t2:#374151;--t3:#6B7280;--t4:#9CA3AF;
  --grn:#1A6B3B;--red:#991B1B;--amb:#92400E;
  --side:#1B1F27;
  --r:6px;--r-lg:12px;--r-pill:999px;
  --sh-xs:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);--sh-sm:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
html{font-size:16px}
body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:var(--t1);background:var(--bg);display:flex;min-height:100vh}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
/* ── Sidebar ─────────────────────────────── */
.sidebar{width:196px;min-width:196px;background:var(--side);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:16px 10px}
.logo{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;padding:2px 10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);margin-bottom:12px}
.logo span{color:#8B7FD6}
.side-lbl{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:0 10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:2px}
.nav.active{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.nav.dim{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
.side-foot{margin-top:auto;font-size:8.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:10px;line-height:1.5}
/* ── Área principal ──────────────────────── */
.wrap{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.topbar{background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);padding:12px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.tb-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tb-sub{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:1px}
.tb-meta{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--t3);text-align:right;line-height:1.55}
.tb-meta strong{color:var(--t1)}
.main{padding:18px 24px 32px;flex:1}
.page-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.page-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);margin:2px 0 14px}
/* Aviso */
.warn{background:#FEF3C7;border:1px solid #FDE68A;color:#92400E;font-size:10.5px;
  padding:7px 12px;border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:12px}
/* Sub-tabs */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);margin-bottom:14px}
.tab{padding:6px 14px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--t3);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;font-family:inherit}
.tab:hover{color:var(--t2)}
.tab.active{color:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);font-weight:600;background:var(--brand-sub)}
.pane{display:none}.pane.active{display:block}
/* Overview grid */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(296px,1fr));gap:12px}
.lc-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:var(--sh-xs);transition:box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s}
.lc-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);border-color:var(--bd-md)}
.lc-car-photo{height:150px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;padding:6px}
.lc-car-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.lc-car-ph{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--t4);font-size:10px}
.lc-card-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-model{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.lc-badge{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid currentColor}
.lc-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-kpi{padding:7px 12px;border-right:1px solid var(--bd-lt);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-kpi:nth-child(2n){border-right:none}
.lc-kpi:nth-last-child(-n+2){border-bottom:none}
.lc-kpi-l{font-size:8px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--t4);margin-bottom:2px}
.lc-kpi-v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1}
.lc-kpi-s{font-size:9px;color:var(--t4);margin-top:1px}
.lc-bar{height:2px;background:var(--bd-lt);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px}
.lc-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px}
.lc-cnts{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-cnt{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:6px 3px;border-right:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-cnt:last-child{border-right:none}
.lc-cnt-v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
.lc-cnt-l{font-size:7.5px;color:var(--t4);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:1px}
.lc-ft{padding:8px 12px}
.lc-btn{width:100%;padding:6px;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--brand-bd);
  background:var(--brand-sub);color:var(--brand);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.lc-btn:hover{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
/* Compra toolbar */
.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{padding:4px 11px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid var(--bd-md);background:var(--surface);
  font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:var(--t3);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.chip.active{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.search{flex:1;min-width:180px;max-width:320px;padding:5px 11px;border:1px solid var(--bd-md);
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:10.5px;font-family:inherit;background:var(--surface);color:var(--t1)}
.search:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--brand)}
.btn-exp{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--bd-md);background:var(--surface);
  font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:var(--t2);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.btn-exp:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
/* Subtotais */
.stbar{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:7px 12px;background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:10px;font-size:10px;color:var(--t3)}
.stbar b{color:var(--t1);font-weight:700}
.stbar .pur{color:var(--brand)}.stbar .rd{color:var(--red)}.stbar .am{color:var(--amb)}
/* Tabela */
.tblwrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:var(--surface)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
thead tr{background:var(--surface3);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
th{padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--t3);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
th:hover{color:var(--brand)}
th.td-r{text-align:right}
th .arr{font-size:8px;margin-left:2px}
tbody tr{border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
tbody tr:hover{background:#F8F9FC}
td{padding:5px 8px;vertical-align:middle}
.td-r{text-align:right}
.td-desc{max-width:170px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:10px;color:var(--t2)}
.td-acao{font-size:9.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.sub2{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3)}
.nm{color:var(--t4);font-size:8px}
.c-buy{color:var(--brand)}.c-dim{color:var(--t4)}.c-late{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
.tag{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700}
.t-kb{background:#EDE9FE;color:#4F3EAF}.t-pl{background:#FEF3C7;color:#92400E}
.ac-apro{color:var(--amb)}.ac-sop{color:var(--brand)}.ac-ok{color:var(--grn)}
.obs-dorm1{background:#FFFDF5}.obs-dorm2{background:#FEF9E7}.obs-morto{background:#FEF2F2}
.legend{margin-top:8px;font-size:9px;color:var(--t4);line-height:1.7}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:3.5rem 1rem;color:var(--t4)}
.empty-i{font-size:2.4rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.empty-t{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t3)}
.empty-s{font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
/* ── Mobile ─────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width:900px){
  body{flex-direction:column}
  .sidebar{width:100%;min-width:0;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;gap:10px}
  .logo{padding:0 12px 0 0;border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
  .side-lbl,.side-foot,.nav.dim{display:none}
  .nav{margin-bottom:0;padding:5px 12px;white-space:nowrap}
  .topbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;padding:10px 14px}
  .tb-meta{text-align:left}
  .main{padding:12px 12px 28px}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .toolbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .search{max-width:none}
  .chips{overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap;padding-bottom:4px}
  .chip{flex:0 0 auto}
  .tabs{overflow-x:auto}
  .tab{white-space:nowrap}
  table{min-width:880px}
  .tblwrap{-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
}
@media (max-width:480px){
  .lc-cnts{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .lc-cnt{flex:1 1 33%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
  .lc-cnt:nth-last-child(-n+3){border-bottom:none}
}
@media print{.sidebar,.toolbar,.tabs,.lc-btn{display:none!important}body{background:#fff}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="logo">RG<span>dB</span> · Hub</div>
  <div class="side-lbl">Workspaces</div>
  <div class="nav dim" title="Disponível no Parts Planning Hub"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><rect width="7" height="7" x="3" y="3" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="14" y="3" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="14" y="14" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="3" y="14" rx="1"/></svg> Kanban C2/PD</div>
  <div class="nav active"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><path d="M19 14c1.49-1.46 3-3.21 3-5.5A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 16.5 3c-1.76 0-3 .5-4.5 2-1.5-1.5-2.74-2-4.5-2A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 2 8.5c0 2.3 1.5 4.05 3 5.5l7 7Z"/></svg> Legacy Care</div>
  <div class="nav dim" title="Disponível no Parts Planning Hub"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><polyline points="22 7 13.5 15.5 8.5 10.5 2 17"/><polyline points="16 7 22 7 22 13"/></svg> Planejamento</div>

  <div class="nav dim" title="Disponível no Parts Planning Hub"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg> Evolução</div>

<div class="wrap">

    <div class="lc-cnt"><div class="lc-cnt-v" style="color:var(--grn)">1.117</div><div class="lc-cnt-l">c/ Estoque</div></div>

    <div class="lc-model">Kangoo</div>

<script>
'use strict';
var curModel = 'all';

function switchTab(t, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('active'); });
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('pane-' + t).classList.add('active');
}

function setModel(m, el) {
  curModel = m;
  document.querySelectorAll('#chips .chip').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('active'); });
  el.classList.add('active');
  applyFilters();
}

function showCompra(modelo) {
  switchTab('compra', document.getElementById('tabb-compra'));
  var chip = document.querySelector('#chips .chip[data-m="' + modelo + '"]');
  if (chip) setModel(modelo, chip);
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

function applyFilters() {
  var q = document.getElementById('busca').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var n = 0, buy = 0, inv = 0, red = 0, yel = 0;
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(function(r) {
    var okM = (curModel === 'all' || r.dataset.modelo === curModel);
    var okQ = (!q || r.dataset.q.indexOf(q) >= 0);
    var show = okM && okQ;
    r.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
    if (show) {
      n++;
      var cr = parseFloat(r.dataset.cr) || 0;
      if (cr > 0) { buy++; inv += cr; }
      if (r.dataset.sema === 'red') red++;
      if (r.dataset.sema === 'yellow') yel++;
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('st-n').textContent = n.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
  document.getElementById('st-b').textContent = buy.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
  document.getElementById('st-i').textContent = 'R$ ' + inv.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
  document.getElementById('st-r').textContent = red;
  document.getElementById('st-y').textContent = yel;
}

var sortState = { col: -1, asc: false };
function sortBy(ci, type, th) {
  var tb = document.getElementById('tbody');
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(tb.querySelectorAll('tr'));
  var asc = (sortState.col === ci) ? !sortState.asc : (type === 't');
  sortState = { col: ci, asc: asc };
  rows.sort(function(a, b) {
    var ca = a.cells[ci], cb = b.cells[ci];
    var va, vb;
    if (type === 'n') {
      va = parseFloat(ca.getAttribute('data-v')) || 0;
      vb = parseFloat(cb.getAttribute('data-v')) || 0;
    } else {
      va = ca.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
      vb = cb.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    }
    if (va < vb) return asc ? -1 : 1;
    if (va > vb) return asc ? 1 : -1;
    return 0;
  });
  rows.forEach(function(r){ tb.appendChild(r); });
  document.querySelectorAll('th .arr').forEach(function(a){ a.remove(); });
  var s = document.createElement('span');
  s.className = 'arr';
  s.textContent = asc ? '▲' : '▼';
  th.appendChild(s);
}

function exportCSV() {
  var linhas = [['Semaforo','Material','Modelo','Descricao','Tipo','Estoque','Media','Kanban','Compra','R$ Compra','Transito','Cart.Forn','Idade CF','Acao']];
  document.querySelectorAll('#tbody tr').forEach(function(r) {
    if (r.style.display === 'none') return;
    var c = r.cells;
    var matModelo = c[1].textContent.trim().split('\n');
    linhas.push([
      c[0].textContent.trim(),
      (c[1].querySelector('.mono') || {textContent:''}).textContent.trim(),
      r.dataset.modelo,
      c[2].textContent.trim(),
      c[3].textContent.trim(),
      c[4].getAttribute('data-v'), c[5].getAttribute('data-v'), c[6].getAttribute('data-v'),
      c[7].getAttribute('data-v'), c[8].getAttribute('data-v'),
      c[9].getAttribute('data-v'), c[10].getAttribute('data-v'), c[11].getAttribute('data-v'),
      c[12].textContent.trim()
    ]);
  });
  var csv = '\ufeff' + linhas.map(function(l) {
    return l.map(function(v){ return '"' + String(v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }).join(';');
  }).join('\r\n');
  var blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'compra_legacy_' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.csv';
  a.click();
}

applyFilters();
</script>
</body>
</html>
